Bali Five-Star Boutique Sustainable Jungle Villas Amid Rice Paddies

Tabanan, Indonesia

Find your slice of jungle paradise at Nirjhara, a serene five-star sanctuary set in the timeless landscape of Tabanan. Bali opulence is taken to new heights at this sustainable enclave, with each intimate suite and villa surrounded by verdant rice fields and lush tropical foliage, and offering luxe touches like rooftop baths or private infinity pools. If you can bear to leave your private kingdom, myriad deluxe facilities await: dive into the glistening pool, relax by the property's waterfall or sink into serenity at the tranquil day spa.
